# Role Onboarding Checklist

Use this checklist when assigning a role to a team member on a new project. Customize based on your team's specific onboarding needs.

---

## General Onboarding Steps

### 1. Role Assignment
- [ ] Identify and assign the role owner
- [ ] Document the assignment in the project charter or team roster
- [ ] Communicate the assignment to the team and relevant stakeholders

### 2. Access and Tools
- [ ] Grant access to project repository and relevant codebases
- [ ] Add to project board(s) and tracking tools (e.g., Jira, GitHub Projects)
- [ ] Provide access to communication channels (e.g., Slack, Teams)
- [ ] Set up necessary development or design tools
- [ ] Configure permissions for deployment and CI/CD systems (if applicable)

### 3. Context and Documentation
- [ ] Share project charter, problem statement, and success metrics
- [ ] Link to relevant design docs, architecture diagrams, and technical specs
- [ ] Point to the role definition and responsibilities (see [roles-and-personas.md](../octoacme-roles-and-personas.md))
- [ ] Provide access to past retrospectives, decision logs, and lessons learned

### 4. Introductions and Alignment
- [ ] Schedule an introduction meeting with the Project Manager and Product Manager
- [ ] Introduce to key collaborators and stakeholders
- [ ] Review team communication cadence (standups, planning, reviews)
- [ ] Clarify reporting structure and escalation paths

### 5. Success Criteria and Expectations
- [ ] Define role-specific success criteria and deliverables
- [ ] Align on timelines and dependencies with the Project Manager
- [ ] Establish check-in cadence for feedback and support
- [ ] Document any specific quality or performance standards

### 6. First Deliverables
- [ ] Identify the first task or deliverable for the role
- [ ] Ensure the new team member has everything needed to start
- [ ] Pair with an experienced team member (if applicable)
- [ ] Schedule a follow-up within the first week to address questions

---

## Role-Specific Notes

_Customize this section with any role-specific onboarding steps (e.g., for Developers: clone repos and set up local environment; for UX Designers: access design system and prototype tools)._

## Tips for Effective Onboarding

- Onboard early: Bring new role owners into the project as soon as their responsibilities begin.
- Be explicit: Don't assume knowledge—provide links, context, and examples.
- Check in regularly: Onboarding doesn't end after day one. Schedule follow-ups to ensure success.
- Iterate: Update this checklist based on feedback from recently onboarded team members.
